chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
But upon those who take him as their guardian.

key_terms.يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُمْ: Those who take him as guardian/master

ai.seo_question: Who does Satan have authority over according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifying that Satan's authority (*sulṭān*) is conditional, applying specifically to those who consciously choose him as a master rather than being absolute over all believers. This distinction underscores the Shia theological principle of free will, where spiritual subjugation is a result of one's own choice to follow Satan's whispers, thereby preserving the integrity of divine justice.
